The BJP on Wednesday targeted the INDIA alliance and Congress leader Rahul Gandhi over the Karthigai Deepam row, accusing the Tamil Nadu government of defying the Supreme Court's directions and showing contempt for the Constitution.
Addressing a press conference, BJP Rajya Sabha MP Sudhanshu Trivedi said the state government did not implement the Supreme Court's order permitting the lighting of the Karthigai Deepam lamp, subject to certain conditions, on November 24.
